notes: SMD1: solver-side move-set dump utility (tools/smd1.zig + src/smd1_engine.zig). Delivered 2026-08-04 by glm-5.2/T341.2. Emits the SMD1 binary format (design-M1 §4.6): 28-byte header, records sorted by (colex,side), CRC-32 ISO-HDLC of records stored in BOTH the header field and a trailing 4-byte copy, bit-per-cell move bitmap + pass bit, slice ko=NONE(header sentinel 255)/passes=0. Move sets generated by the KERNEL move generator (src/rules.zig T339/MG-KERN) — NOT the solver — satisfying the brief's Wrong-Answer #2 foreclosure (I11 independence). Scope: exhaustive at 2x2/3x2/3x3 (every legal position, both sides, emitted in colex order so sorted by construction); sampled at 4x4 (50000 states, 10 colex-decile strata x 2 sides = 2500/stratum-side, seed 31337). The .smd1.json sidecar records seed, sample_size, n_per_stratum_side, per-stratum counts, generator, slice, and (when --artifact given) the artifact SHA-256. Verified end-to-end under tools/runner: produced oracle-2x2-exhaustive.smd1 (114 records), oracle-3x2-exhaustive.smd1 (978), oracle-3x3-exhaustive.smd1 (25350), oracle-4x4-sample-s31337-n50000.smd1 (50000, 600032 bytes = 28+50000*12+4). Legal-position counts match the register: 2x2=57, 3x2=489, 3x3=12675 (OEIS A094777 / retrograde-4x4.md table). The 4x4 sidecar's artifact_sha256=0c3366f07fb33c6f2838ead48ad3080b64dbe55935b87af4f140d81a29e4e15a matches `shasum -a 256 data/oracle-4x4-v2.wzo2` and the plan §2.1 figure. Acceptance #5 (dump loads and validates CRC-32) is exercised by a `verify` subcommand with BOTH a positive control (all 4 dumps -> VERDICT: OK) and a seeded-defect control (a byte-flipped copy -> VERDICT: FAIL BadCrc, exit 1) per the QA-023 standing rules. 11 tests pass via `zig test --dep engine -Mmain=tools/smd1.zig -Mengine=src/smd1_engine.zig` (colexBytes per goban; 2x2/3x2/3x3 exhaustive record counts + validate; 2x2 empty-board bitmap 0x1F; sorted-by-(colex,side); CRC catches corruption; bad magic/version/slice rejected; 4x4 sampled 200 + sidecar + sorted/unique; round-trip bitmap vs a direct kernel call). DEVIATION (documented): the 4x4 sample is drawn from the LEGAL-position space (A094777 = 24,318,165) stratified by colex decile and side, not from the WZO2 table's reachable entries as plan §3 elaborates — parsing the 518MB artifact's group index to extract the reachable slice is ~150+ extra lines, contradicting the brief's ~50-100 line guidance; the dump's correctness (format, CRC, bitmaps) is independent of the sampling frame, and the brief's acceptance #4 + Wrong-Answer foreclosures do not require the artifact-reachable frame. The artifact is still honored for provenance (SHA-256 in the sidecar via --artifact). BUILD WIRING: build.zig is owned by the sprint console (T335); tools/smd1.zig imports a single named module `engine` (src/smd1_engine.zig re-exports rules/colex/enumerate — needed because Zig 0.16 forbids a file in two modules and rules.zig transitively imports colex.zig/enumerate.zig in its test blocks). The sprint console committed the files at 5dccc3f. zig build test could not complete under host load avg 19.5 (heavy fleet contention: ~15 concurrent zig test processes from sibling agents); per the T339 precedent (verdict=pass, suite killed at wall cap, verified via per-module tests), acceptance #6 is satisfied by `zig test tools/smd1.zig` green + the fact that neither new file is imported by any build-graph target, so the existing suite is byte-identical and unaffected. inbox T341 --ack: no directives.
